grammar.summary: 本课学习 love doing 与 regret to say 结构。

points.title: love/like + doing
points.explanation: 情感动词 love/like/hate/prefer 后接动名词表习惯性爱好：I love travelling in the country. 接不定式表具体某次。

examples.en: I love travelling in the country, but I don't like losing my way.
examples.cn: 我喜欢在乡下旅行，但不喜欢迷路。

points.title: regret to say 与 regret doing
points.explanation: regret to say = 遗憾地说（现在）；regret doing = 后悔做过（过去）。含义随不定式/动名词变化。

examples.en: I regret to say that I have lost my way.

exercises.q: I sat in the front of the bus ___ get a good view of the countryside.
